title: 第一千六百二十三章 准备撤退第一千六百二十二章 仙术咫尺天涯
content_zh:
白雪凤的话如同一记重锤，狠狠砸在刘长旭心上，让他一时间难以相信自己的耳朵。
北冥仙宫作为北冥仙域的霸主，经营这座仙岛已不知多少万年，根基之深不可想象。
不说那些遍布岛中的隐秘法阵禁制，单是传承下来的护岛大阵，便曾抵御过无数次仙域浩劫。
在他看来，即便没有北冥仙帝亲自坐镇，仅凭仙宫的底蕴，也绝非短时间内能被撼动的。
更何况，如今北冥仙帝尚在！那位准帝强者虽在与鲲鹏妖帝的对决中落于下风，却并未伤及根本，有他主持大阵，再加上仙宫众修士的合力加持，纵使鲲鹏妖帝实力强横，想要攻破北冥仙岛的防御，也该是一场旷日持久的拉锯战，怎会沦落到“守不住”的地步？
刘长旭眉头紧锁，忍不住追问道：
“前辈，这……这实在让人难以置信。难道出了特殊的变数？”
他心中飞速盘算着各种可能，却始终无法将“北冥仙宫失守”与眼前的局势联系起来。
北冥仙岛早已是北冥仙域人族修士心中的最坚固堡垒，若连它都守不住，那这片仙域的未来，又将何去何从？
“据我们得到的最新情报，正有两位准帝级妖族强者向北冥海赶来，估计这几日便到。到那时，我们根本挡不住三位准帝级强者的围攻！”
白雪凤语气沉重的说道：
“那我们就没有援军吗？”
刘长旭语气急切的说道：
“有，无极仙域的无极仙帝正在赶来的路上，由于和我们北冥仙域没有直通的超远距离传送阵，距离太远，想要赶到，需要一个多月的时间，根本来不及。所以，仙帝决定，一旦挡不住，立刻撤离！”
白雪凤无奈的说道：
听了白雪凤的讲述，刘长旭总算明白了事情的大致缘由。
不过，刘长旭心里还是有很多不解，为啥北冥仙帝仅仅争取了一位同阶强者来援，是与周边仙域同阶人族强者的关系不佳，还是，周边人族的准帝强者人品低劣，不肯伸出援手。
他沉吟片刻，看向白雪凤，将心中疑问直言道出：
“白前辈，北冥仙域遭遇灭顶危机，为何仅仅只有无极仙帝愿意出手帮忙？其余仙域的准帝强者，为何全都作壁上观？”
白雪凤闻言轻轻一叹，眉宇间满是苍凉道：

“长旭道友，此事说来复杂，但也简单。
首先，妖族此番出动两位准妖帝，可谓势大，其他人族准帝知道这个情况后，谁也不愿为其它仙域的事赌上自身道途性命。”
“其二，各大仙域之间，早已隔阂深重。自古仙域疆土争夺、灵脉划分、上古传承恩怨数不胜数。不少仙域甚至暗中乐见北冥仙域与北冥妖族两败俱伤，待双方战力耗尽，他们便可坐收渔翁之利。”
“还有最重要一点，这次妖族声势浩大，各方准帝推演天机，察觉此次大乱仅仅只是开端。不少强者判断，这是人族与妖族全面大战的序幕，人人都想保存自身实力，固守自家仙域，不愿率先卷入纷争，成为妖族首要针对的目标。”
白雪凤顿了顿，继续说道：
“北冥仙帝也曾接连传信周边六各大仙域，恳请诸位准帝联手共抗妖祸。奈何求援信送出很多，要么石沉大海，要么收到委婉推脱的回复。仅有无极仙帝，念昔年与北冥仙帝有一段深厚交情，不顾路途遥远，星夜兼程赶来。可惜距离太远，远水解不了近渴。”
刘长旭默然不语，心中泛起一股寒意。
大敌当前，人族各大顶尖强者依旧各怀心思，一盘散沙。若是三位妖族准帝攻破北冥仙岛，屠戮北冥仙域人族，下一步，妖族必然向外扩张，
content_en:
Bai Xuefeng's words were like a heavy hammer, hitting Liu Changxu's heart so hard that he couldn't believe his ears for a while.
As the overlord of the Beiming Immortal Domain, Beiming Immortal Palace has been running this fairy island for countless thousands of years, and its foundation is unimaginably deep.
Not to mention the secret magic circle restrictions all over the island, the inherited island protection formation alone has withstood countless catastrophes in the fairyland.
In his opinion, even without Immortal Emperor Beiming personally taking charge, the foundation of the Immortal Palace alone cannot be shaken in a short time.
What's more, Immortal Emperor Beiming is still here! Although the strong quasi-emperor was at a disadvantage in the duel with the Kunpeng Demon Emperor, he did not damage the foundation. With him presiding over the formation, and with the joint support of the monks from the Immortal Palace, even if the Kunpeng Demon Emperor was powerful, it would be a protracted tug-of-war to break through the defenses of the Beiming Immortal Island. How could he be reduced to the point of "undefendable"?
Liu Changxu frowned and couldn't help but ask:
"Senior, this... this is really unbelievable. Is there a special change?"
He was rapidly calculating various possibilities in his mind, but he was still unable to connect the "fall of Beiming Immortal Palace" with the situation in front of him.
The Beiming Immortal Island has long been the strongest fortress in the hearts of the human monks in the Beiming Immortal Territory. If it cannot be defended, then where will the future of this Immortal Territory go?
"According to the latest information we have received, two quasi-emperor-level demon clan powerhouses are rushing towards Beiminghai, and they are expected to arrive in the next few days. By then, we will not be able to stop the siege of the three quasi-emperor-level powerhouses!"
Bai Xuefeng said in a serious tone:
"Then we don't have reinforcements?"
Liu Changxu said urgently:
"Yes, the Wuji Immortal Emperor from the Wuji Immortal Territory is on his way over. Since there is no super long-distance teleportation array directly connected to our Beiming Immortal Territory, the distance is too far. It will take more than a month to get there, and there is no time at all. Therefore, the Immortal Emperor decided to evacuate immediately once he cannot stop us!"
Bai Xuefeng said helplessly:
After listening to Bai Xuefeng's story, Liu Changxu finally understood the general reason for the incident.
However, Liu Changxu still had a lot of puzzles in his heart. Why did the Beiming Immortal Emperor only win over a strong person of the same level to come to his aid? Was it because he had a poor relationship with the strong human beings of the same level in the surrounding fairyland, or was it because the quasi-emperor strong people from the surrounding human race were of low character and refused to lend a helping hand.
He pondered for a moment, looked at Bai Xuefeng, and expressed the question in his heart:
"Senior Bai, the Beiming Immortal Territory is facing a crisis of extinction. Why is it that only the Wuji Immortal Emperor is willing to help? Why are all the quasi-emperors of the other Immortal Territories standing aside and watching?"
Bai Xuefeng sighed softly when she heard this, and said with desolation between her brows:
"Fellow Taoist Changxu, this matter is complicated, but it is also simple.
First of all, the demon clan's dispatch of two quasi-demon emperors this time is quite powerful. After the other quasi-monster emperors of the human race knew about this situation, no one was willing to risk their lives for the affairs of other immortal realms. "
"Secondly, there have long been deep estrangements between the major immortal realms. Since ancient times, there have been countless conflicts over the territory of the immortal realms, divisions of spiritual veins, and ancient inheritance grievances. Many immortal realms are even secretly happy to see that both the Beiming Immortal Region and the Beiming Monster Clan will suffer losses. When the combat power of both sides is exhausted, they can reap the benefits."
"And the most important point is that this time the demon clan is so powerful that the quasi-emperors of all parties have deduced the secrets and realized that this chaos is just the beginning. Many strong people judge that this is the prelude to a full-scale war between the human race and the demon clan. Everyone wants to preserve their own strength and stick to their own fairyland. They are unwilling to be the first to get involved in the dispute and become the primary target of the demon clan."
Bai Xuefeng paused and continued:
"Immortal Emperor Beiming has also sent letters to the six surrounding Immortal Regions, imploring all the quasi-emperors to join forces to fight against the demon disaster. However, many letters for help were sent, but they either fell into the sea or received euphemistic replies. Only Immortal Emperor Wuji, remembering his deep friendship with Immortal Emperor Beiming in the past, came here despite the long distance and starry night. Unfortunately, the distance is too far, and distant water cannot quench the near thirst."Liu Changxu remained silent, a chill rising in his heart.
In the face of a formidable enemy, the top warriors of the human race still have their own agendas and are in disarray. If the three demon clan quasi-emperors break through the Beiming Immortal Island and massacre the human race in the Beiming Immortal Domain, the next step will be for the demon clan to expand outwards.
